projects.name: Paris 12
projects.quote: Since the Q3 earnings call, the joint ventures leased an incremental 31 megawatts across the Paris 12 and Paris 13 assets, bringing total xScale leasing to over 400 megawatts globally.

projects.name: Paris 13
projects.quote: Since the Q3 earnings call, the joint ventures leased an incremental 31 megawatts across the Paris 12 and Paris 13 assets, bringing total xScale leasing to over 400 megawatts globally.

projects.name: xScale joint venture with CPP Investments and GIC
projects.counterparty: Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments) and GIC
projects.quote: In October, Equinix announced plans to nearly triple the capital invested in its xScale data center portfolio with the formation of a greater than $15 billion joint venture with Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments) and GIC.

projects.name: Singapore 6
projects.quote: In November, Equinix announced its Singapore 6 build, part of the country’s pilot data center call for application, which will provide 20 megawatts of capacity for next-generation workloads such as AI in one of Asia-Pacific’s fastest-growing digital economies.
